```{r setup}
library(heavilyright)
```

## Combining p-values

Finite-number and approximate calibration are named explicitly.

```{r}
finite_rule <- new_combination("hcauchy", m = 3, calibration = "finite")
combine_p(c(0.01, 0.20, 0.40), finite_rule)
finite_rule$calibration
```

## Calibrating sample means

```{r}
sample <- matrix(c(0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 0.9, 1.1, 0.9, 1.3, 1.0), ncol = 2)
standard_error_of_mean(sample)
covariance_of_mean(sample)
```

The covariance result is `W/[n(n-1)]` and belongs in `study(vcov = ...)`.

## Scalar confidence intervals

```{r}
fit <- fit_meta_1d(
  estimate = c(0.10, 0.14, 0.08),
  se = c(0.04, 0.05, 0.03)
)
fit
confint(fit)
```

## Multivariate regions

```{r}
region <- fit_meta_md(
  list(study(
    c(0.2, -0.1),
    matrix(c(0.04, 0.01, 0.01, 0.09), 2),
    df = 29
  )),
  parameter_dim = 2
)
interval <- support_interval(region, c(1, 0))
interval
interval$upper_diagnostics
```
